claim_scope.profile: ConfigMap PATCH carrying reviewed metadata.resourceVersion R0

held_fixed: cluster/API server, namespace, and ConfigMap identity
valid patch syntax and media type
no concurrent mutation during precondition/effect evaluation
no unrelated admission, validation, transport, policy, quota, or service failure determines the outcome

effect_cut.name: K8S_CONFIGMAP_RESOURCEVERSION_PATCH_EFFECT_CUT
effect_cut.definition: The API-server point at which the supplied metadata.resourceVersion is evaluated for lost-update protection before the ConfigMap patch is committed.
effect_cut.target_effect: The pinned client carries the declared resourceVersion into the PATCH request, so the service-side guard remains operative at this cut.

target_observation_model.surface_projection: Both worlds use the same API operation, but the service-side result remains sensitive to the current resourceVersion because R0 is carried in the request.

ctv_question.deterministic_factorization: Does there exist g such that source consequence kappa_S = g o rho_T for both admitted worlds?
ctv_question.kernel_condition: Any worlds collapsed by rho_T must have the same source consequence.
ctv_question.refinement_requirement: If factorization is consistent, each realized target consequence must explicitly refine to the required source consequence.

freeze_rule: Worlds, effect cut, held-fixed dimensions, target realizations, refinement map, and claim scope are immutable after this boundary model is committed and before primary validation.
